mapper.insert: insert into coupon (name, type, value, min_amount, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{value}, #{minAmount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update coupon
name = #{name},
type = #{type},
value = #{value},
min_amount = #{minAmount},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from coupon where status = 1 order by id desc
